axiom_ledger.inference_and_applicability: The legend identifies diagonal blue hatching as H₂. Because b and c start at the same zero baseline and are plotted on the same linear mole-percentage axis, the visibly higher top of b's blue segment directly entails that b has the greater H₂ mole percentage. This is an interpretation of the chart's graphical encoding for this experiment, not a general chemical law.
